youtube.title: Why is 13 the unluckiest number? 😨 #Shorts
youtube.description: Why would the most modern buildings on Earth pretend a floor is not there? The answer starts thousands of years ago. At the Last Supper, thirteen sat at the table, and one of them betrayed Jesus. In Norse myth, Loki crashed a feast of twelve gods as the thirteenth guest, and by night's end Balder was dead. Over centuries the story hardened into a rule: thirteen brings death. Full episode on the channel. #Shorts #Friday13th #mythology #history #thehiddenwhy

instagram.caption: Thirteen at the Last Supper. Loki, the thirteenth guest, at a feast of twelve gods. Centuries later the stories hardened into one rule: thirteen brings death. That is why even modern buildings pretend a floor is not there. #thehiddenwhy #mythology #superstition #history
